front_ref5.role: single front ref5 candidate; anatomy LEFT projects viewer RIGHT

back_comparison_only.role: back orientation comparison only; anatomy LEFT projects viewer LEFT; NOT first-experiment input

observations: Front native and 4x show no eyes; both original visible red beads and their bob-to-bead-to-proximal-curl connection are inside the crop, not cut at the crop boundary. Both lower bob sides, lower face/jaw and neck/collar context distinguish a frontal head.
Frontal anatomical LEFT is viewer RIGHT. The original frontal ear/lobe and posterior nape are partly hidden by bob; this crop does not reveal or reconstruct a hidden full ear.

Back crop separately demonstrates the same anatomical LEFT on viewer LEFT, with bob/nape/proximal beads/curl naturally overlapping. It is orientation comparison only, not an additional first-experiment bitmap.
approved_scope_proposed: One front ref5 for low anatomical LEFT root relation to lower bob/neck and two-bead-to-proximal-curl continuity only.
restrictions: Own current PV head yaw/roll, anatomy and occlusion determine projection. Do not transfer the crop screen-right position, front-facing jaw, or near-ear visibility to every pose; far LEFT may be hidden.
Lower face/mouth/nose sliver, skin, collar/tie/vest and shoulders are incidental pixels, NOT face/expression, skin-color or costume authority.
Polished original highlights/shadows and pigment appearance are NOT new shading/material authority. Current flat material policy still applies.
This is a proximal-root crop: lower turn continues beyond the bottom crop. Do not infer full coil length/count/axis/taper or missing hidden geometry from its crop boundary.
No eye outline, iris, aperture, gaze or glint template is supplied.

Use the native front crop only as ref5 in the first experiment; 4x images are inspection diagnostics, back image comparison only. Existing side ref retained unchanged; no global policy/default adoption.
